build.method: Expo CNG prebuild plus Gradle :app:assembleRelease in a disposable short-path copy
build.signing_identity: generated Android debug certificate; not production signing

runtime.test_environment: Repository local Expo environment embedded; values redacted; runtime connectivity not exercised
runtime.device_discovery: ADB started successfully and reported no attached devices

acceptance_cases.expected_result: A clean installed Android binary completes sign-in, enrollment, assignment, preparation, and reaches a truthful ready state.
acceptance_cases.actual_result: An installable APK exists, but ADB reported no attached device; no physical runtime step was executed.

acceptance_cases.expected_result: A prepared app cold-starts in airplane mode with scoped cached catalog, cash flow, and receipt access inside the grant window.
acceptance_cases.actual_result: Requires the completed A01 physical-device baseline and was not executed.

acceptance_cases.expected_result: First-install offline or incomplete preparation reports preparation required and never reports ready.
acceptance_cases.actual_result: No physical clean installation was available.

acceptance_cases.expected_result: An in-place binary upgrade preserves unresolved transaction identity, payload, secret, sequence, and exactly-once recovery.
acceptance_cases.actual_result: Requires a prior installed binary and physical custody fixture; neither exists yet.

acceptance_cases.expected_result: The actual signed AAB passes target API, manifest, native-library, and 16 KB qualification.
acceptance_cases.actual_result: The local APK passed a preliminary 16 KB zipalign check, but it is ARM64-only, debug-key signed, and is not the production AAB.
